北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，注意防护哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Haze in Beijing, remember to wear a mask and protect yourself!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 13℃，风力 3级，添衣保暖，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like 13℃ with a 3-level wind, dress warm and don't catch a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 15℃，早晚温差大，记得加件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 15℃, big temperature difference, remember to grab a jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 30℃ 左右，依然很热，注意防晒补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels around 30℃, still hot, remember sun protection and hydration!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 28℃，湿度不低，穿衣清爽透气最舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels 28℃ with decent humidity, light and breathable clothing is best.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 16℃，户外活动记得添衣哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels like 16℃, remember to add a layer for outdoor activities!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗但体感 13℃，小心着凉，记得多穿一点。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but feels like 13℃, be careful not to catch a cold, dress warmer.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 17℃，湿度较高，出门带伞有备无患。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels 17℃, high humidity, bring an umbrella just in case.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 18℃，戴好口罩，注意防护和保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Haze in Wuhan, feels 18℃, wear a mask, stay protected and warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 13℃，湿度 12%，非常干燥，记得多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels 13℃ with 12% humidity, very dry, remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天体感 16℃，湿度大，记得带把伞防潮气哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels 16℃, high humidity, bring an umbrella for the dampness.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 7℃，风力 3级，出门务必多穿，小心着凉！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like 7℃ with a 3-level wind, definitely layer up when going out, watch out for colds!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳风力 4级体感 10℃，风大天凉，注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has 4-level winds and feels 10℃, windy and cool, remember wind protection and warmth.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云体感 18℃，风力 3级，户外记得加件薄外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels 18℃ with a 3-level wind, remember a light jacket for outdoors.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 27℃，舒适宜人，享受美好时光吧！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels 27℃, pleasant and comfortable, enjoy your lovely time!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾体感 4℃，湿度 80%，路滑天冷，注意交通安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has heavy fog, feels 4℃ with 80% humidity, slippery roads and cold, drive safe.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾体感 10℃，风力 3级，出门记得戴好口罩保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has haze, feels 10℃ with a 3-level wind, remember to wear a mask and stay warm.
